main_text.p: Hi enim hos Pfalmos pertinere putant ad illa tempora, quibus pij finguli é fuis ftationibus adfcendebant Hierofolyma, apparituri folenni modo coram facie Domini: quem ritum lex docet quamplurimis locis, & Prophera celebrat Pfalmo 42. & 84. & 132. exemplaque docent in Vetere & Nouo Teftamento paffim.

Illi veró ad tempus reuerfionis ex Babylonia iudicant pertinere: fiue vt adfcendentes Hierofolyma fe his meditationibus fanctis confirmarent, aliique alios inter fe hortarentur, fiue vt liberationis illius diuinæ memoriam his facris cantionibus meditationibusque recolerent. Verùm cùm iftarù rerum, vtut fpeciofæ fint, nullum veftigium in fcripturis compareat, mihi religio eft ex narrationibus eiufmodi, quas fola coniectura gignit, interpretationes afferre, & res probandas tanquam probatas & compertas in medium adducere. Quod fi ex coniecturis folum agendum effet, mallem Hebræam vocem adfcenfus quidem exponere, fed ita vt de fpiritali piorum eue&ione ad Dominú potius quàm de corporali motu intelligeretur: quæ interpretatio cum ea ipfa quam nos ampleéti- mur conuenientiam effet habitura. Sin gradus malit quis reddere, vt Efai.38. hos Pfalmos fecundum horas folario diftinctas cantatos in templodixerim (vt de Pfalmo 22. teftatur inscriptio) poft reuerfionē Babylone. His itaque omnibus

page.notes: Printed text is set in roman type with a long s rendered as s. The word "ampleéti-" carries an accent-like mark over the e that I cannot resolve with certainty, so it is given as printed. The "Hebræam" line is hyphenated at the line end as "vo-". The first paragraph continues from the previous page. The last line ends mid-sentence and continues on the next page. The signature mark at the lower left is faint and only partly legible. Small mark after "confirma-" in the left margin is a stray speck, not text. Numbers (42, 84, 132, 38, 22) are copied as printed.
